title: Disney On Ice: Discover the Magic
desc:
There are few experiences quite like watching a child’s eyes light up as Mickey Mouse skates onto the ice, hearing an arena erupt with excitement when Elsa creates her icy world, or singing along with favorite Disney songs surrounded by family and friends.

This year, Disney On Ice marks its 45th Anniversary, honoring four and a half decades of bringing Disney stories to life through the artistry of world-class figure skating. Every production blends breathtaking skating, stunning costumes, spectacular special effects, immersive sets, dazzling lighting, and high-flying acrobatics with innovative storytelling. 

Join the celebration and experience the magic that has become a cherished tradition for generations of families!

title: Peter Pan
desc:
Fly away to Neverland this festive season!

Adapted by Phil Porter with original music by Ruth Chan and directed by Joe Murphy, this faithful, enchanting re-telling of J M Barrie’s classic tale is a magical family show bursting with imagination, flying, and original songs.

Access performances

  • Relaxed (Sun 10 Jan 11am)
  • Audio Described (Sat 12 Dec & Sat 9 Jan at 2pm with pre-show Touch Tour at 12:30pm)
  • BSL Interpreted (Thu 3 Dec at 10:15am & 2:30pm, Fri 4 Dec at 6:30pm)
  • Captioned dates across select November, December, and January performances.

title: Birmingham Royal Ballet - Swan Lake
desc:
A spellbinding celebration of classical ballet and music

Birmingham Royal Ballet revives Sir Peter Wright and Galina Samsova’s glorious journey into Swan Lake – with the Royal Ballet Sinfonia performing Tchaikovsky’s superb music live alongside BRB’s spectacular dancers.

Prince Siegfried is out hunting one night when he happens upon a flock of graceful swans. When one of them turns into a beautiful woman, the Prince is utterly smitten – but Odette explains that she has fallen under an evil spell cast by Baron von Rothbart, which keeps her in swan form from dawn to dusk. Can Siegfried’s love break the spell?

Find out in this exquisite production of a true ballet classic.

Access Performances & Touch Tours

  • Touch Tour: Sat 26 Sep, 11.15am (Familiarise with set, props, and costumes)

  • Audio Described: Sat 26 Sep, 2pm

Note: BSL, Captioned, and Relaxed performances vary by date. Please check the access registration portal.

Credit: Céline Gittens as Odette and Odile. © Manvir Rai.

title: Treasure Island
desc:
Ahoy, Wolverhampton! A brand-new swashbuckling panto adventure for the 2026/27 festive season.

Fresh from clinching Best Panto in the UK at the UK Pantomime Awards, Wolverhampton Grand is premiering a never-before-seen pantomime adventure starring firm audience favourites Tam Ryan and Ian Adams. Expect high-seas slapstick, dazzling sets, and accessible festive fun for all ages.

Wolverhampton Grand provides dedicated relaxed and sensory-adapted performances featuring softened stage effects, lowered sound volume, and access to quiet breakout areas.

Key Accessible Performances & Highlights:

  • Relaxed Performances – Thursday 10 December at 11am | Friday 11 December at 11am | Saturday 12 December at 11am
  • Audio Described Performances – Sunday 6 December at 3pm | Tuesday 8 December at 10.30am | Saturday 2 January at 2pm
  • BSL Interpreted Performances – Thursday 10 December at 11am & 7pm | Friday 11 December at 11am | Saturday 12 December at 11am | Sunday 3 January at 11am
  • Captioned Performance – Sunday 6 December at 3pm

title: Sleeping Beauty
desc:
A firm family favourite returns to the Hippodrome stage: Birmingham pantomime legends Matt Slack and Andrew Ryan return to bring spectacular festive laughs, magic, and show-stopping musical numbers to this brand-new production of Sleeping Beauty.

Key Accessible Performances & Highlights:

  • BSL Interpreted: Sun 10 Jan (1pm & 5.15pm) – Interpreted by Rachel Tipping & Clare Edwards
  • Captioned: Sun 17 Jan (1pm & 5.15pm)
  • Audio Described: Wed 13 Jan (2pm) & Sat 16 Jan (2.30pm)
  • Relaxed Performance: Thu 28 Jan (12:00 noon)

title: Robin Hood
desc:
Arrow-right into pure panto perfection!

Join our merry crew for double the laughter, double the fun, and double the Ben as the Lichfield Garrick presents its first in-house pantomime in over a decade.

Accessible Performances:

  • Relaxed Performance on Sunday 29th November at 11am
  • BSL Signed Performances on Thursday 17th December at 7pm and Sunday 3rd January at 11am.

Read more about the upcoming show and full story on Lichfields Garricks first in-house panto in over a decade here

title: Aladdin Pantomime
desc:
Make Christmas Wishes Come True, with magical Mark, David, Sam and YOU!

Climb aboard the magic carpet and soar into the spectacular world of Aladdin – The unmissable family pantomime for 2026 starring Mark Rhodes, David Phipps-Davis and Samantha Spragg!

Will Aladdin outwit the wicked sorcerer, claim his fortune, and win the heart of his true love, Jasmine? Join us to find out in a spellbinding adventure bursting with laughter, wonder, and festive cheer.

Packed with side-splitting comedy, dazzling costumes, and show-stopping musical numbers, Aladdin has all the ingredients for the ultimate Christmas treat.

Accessible Performances

  • Relaxed Performance: December 19, 11am
  • BSL Interpreted Performance: December 27, 1pm

title: Beauty and the Beast
desc:
For Christmas 2026, the Belgrade presents the most enchanting tale of all, Beauty and the Beast!

One of the most popular panto titles ever, this production is guaranteed to bring a touch of magic, mayhem and monstrous fun to your festive celebrations.

Written by and starring Coventry’s favourite dame, Iain Lauchlan, Beauty and the Beast features breathtaking sets, crazy costumes, and seasonal silliness.

Accessible & Special Performances:

  • Touch Tour available on Sat 5 Dec (11:30am)
  • Audio Described (AD) & BSL on Sat 5 Dec (2pm)
  • Captioned (CAP) on Thu 17 Dec (6:30pm)
  • Captioned & Relaxed Performance (CAP/RP) on Wed 30 Dec (2pm)
  • Lap seat tickets and free booster seats available via the box office (Booster seats limited).

title: Dog Man: The Musical
desc: With the head of a dog and the body of a policeman, Dog Man loves to fight crime and chew on furniture!.. Paw-sitively brilliant stage adaptation based on Dav Pilkey's worldwide bestselling Dog Man book series.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire the Musical
desc:
Say "Helloooo, Birmingham!" The critically acclaimed West End and Broadway musical comedy Mrs. Doubtfire launches its very first UK and Ireland tour right here at Birmingham Hippodrome! Starring Gabriel Vick reprising his acclaimed West End role, this hilarious and heartwarming family show is packed with iconic moments, brilliant original songs, and spectacular quick-changes as Daniel Hillard goes to extraordinary lengths to stay in his children's lives.

Key Accessible Performances:

  • Captioned: Thu 27 Aug & Thu 10 Sep (7.30pm) – by Stevie Burrows
  • BSL Interpreted: Wed 26 Aug & Wed 9 Sep (7.30pm)
  • Audio Described: Sat 29 Aug & Sat 12 Sep (2.30pm) – by Jonathan Nash
  • Touch Tour: Sat 29 Aug & Sat 12 Sep (1.15pm)

Find full accessibility information here or contact the Hippodrome access team on 0121 689 1060.

title: Elf The Musical
desc: “You’d have to be a cotton-headed ninny muggins” to miss Buddy the elf this festive season.

title: Paddington The Musical
desc: A small bear in a big city! Family-friendly stage show at London's Savoy Theatre that tells the story of a little lost bear who finds a new home with the Brown family.

title: Spot's Birthday Party
desc:
Spot is having a very special birthday party and you’re invited!

With party hats, songs, dancing and lots of interactive party games, this is going to be the best birthday party ever! Join Steve the monkey, Tom the Crocodile and Helen the Hippo to say a big HAPPY BIRTHDAY SPOT!

Based on the beloved Eric Hill classic Happy Birthday Spot, this brand-new adaptation brings your favourite pup and his friends to life in an interactive and accessible show suitable for ages 2+ and their grown ups.

title: The Gingerbread Boy
desc:
Deep in Fairy-tale Forest lives a remarkable boy made entirely of gingerbread! 

His lonely world is changed forever when Blake, a young lad from a nearby village, stumbles upon his incredible cookie cottage. Together, the two boys embark on a madcap journey of discovery. And it’s Christmas Eve too … another surprise visitor is on his way!

Full of heart, laughter and song – and a healthy helping of cake – The Gingerbread Boy is a brand-new Christmas story about friendship and celebrating our differences. The perfect festive treat for ages 3+. 

Ticket includes a free present for every child!

title: The Spooky Magic Show
desc:
Rufus the Dog has taken Uncle Cadabra’s powerful magic wand thinking it was a bone and hidden in the attic.

Accidentally Rufus has caused the whole audience to be magically transported into the enchanted attic. It is up to apprentice sorcerer Sam, and helpers in the audience, to find all the ingredients needed to make a magic spell that will transport everyone home!

A magical story for young families, which is spooky but not scary. The show features a large number of magic tricks and illusions as well as puppets. Members of the audience take part and help Sam with many of the tricks on stage.

title: Freezin
desc:
Snow is falling… and Jack Frost is calling! 

When the wicked Jack Frost sweeps into the kingdom and casts a spell of eternal winter, fountains freeze, forests frost over and the Royal Palace is plunged into chaos! With his icy powers growing stronger by the minute, he’s determined to keep the kingdom frozen forever… But brave Princess Honour won’t let that happen! 

Teaming up with the hilarious and hopelessly silly, Silly Snowy, she sets off on a magical mission to stop Jack Frost and help her sister, Queen Ellie, learn to control her extraordinary ice powers before it’s too late. Packed with dazzling costumes, spectacular scenery, toe-tapping tunes, laugh-out-loud comedy and plenty of boos for the baddie, FREEZIN’ is the ultimate October half-term treat for the whole family!

A 90-minute family-friendly show filled with dazzling costumes, spectacular scenery, toe-tapping tunes, and slapstick comedy.

title: The Snowman™
desc:
Let your imagination take flight. 

Join us for the world premiere of a brand-new production of The Snowman™ as it comes back home to Birmingham and The Rep. 

For 32 years, The Snowman has enchanted theatre audiences, now, discover the next chapter of this much-loved story. Based on Raymond Briggs’ cherished book, The Rep’s sparkling new production features Howard Blake’s iconic score including the classic Walking in the Air, beautifully crafted puppets and of course, a gravity-defying friendship.

When a young boy’s snowman magically comes to life, an unforgettable adventure begins. Together, they journey through the night, gliding hand-in-hand across the starlit sky. Along the way they encounter Father Christmas, friendly reindeer, and a joyful gathering of snow people beneath the shimmering Northern Lights, discovering a world of wonder, friendship and winter magic.

Access Performances & Touch Tours

  • Touch Tour - Saturday 31 Oct 1:30pm - before Audio Described performance.
  • Audio Described - Saturday 31 Oct 3pm
  • Relaxed Friday - 30 Oct 11am

title: SYLVIA
desc:
Sylvia Pankhurst – fearless, flawed, and unforgettable. 

The untold story of the rebellious middle child of Emmeline Pankhurst takes centre stage in this irresistible hip hop, funk and soul musical that moves your feet and fires your spirit. Whilst her mother and sister battled for women’s suffrage, Sylvia ignited a revolution for the forgotten: working women, the impoverished, the silenced. Caught between her family and her beliefs, Sylvia risked it all to bring change to millions. 

With an electrifying score by Josh Cohen and DJ Walde, renowned choreographer and storyteller Kate Prince delivers her Olivier-nominated vision in this theatrical treat. Starring powerhouse talent Beverley Knight in a show stopping performance as Emmeline Pankhurst, alongside Naomi Katiyo as Sylvia Pankhurst.

 Direct from London’s Old Vic theatre, SYLVIA is more than a musical – it’s a manifesto set to music, a revolution you can dance to, a story that roars and shakes the rafters.

Access Performances & Touch Tours


  • BSL Interpreted: Wed 7 Oct, 7.30pm
  • Captioned by Stevie Burrows: Thu 8 Oct, 7.30pm
  • Audio Described by Carole Burn: Sat 10 Oct, 2.30pm
  • Touch Tour: Sat 10 Oct, 1.15pm

title: Birmingham Royal Ballet: The Nutcracker
desc:
At the stroke of midnight on Christmas Eve, Clara tiptoes downstairs and is swept away on an unforgettable magical journey… It’s never too early to secure your seat for Birmingham Royal Ballet’s performances of their spectacular Christmas show, The Nutcracker in November/December 2026.

At her parents’ lavish Christmas party, Clara is given a mysterious Nutcracker Doll. Once all the guests have left, she sneaks downstairs to find her present and comes face-to-face with the fearsome King Rat, ready to do battle with the Nutcracker and his band of toy soldiers. As soon as King Rat is vanquished, Clara is whisked away on a magical adventure with the Nutcracker, travelling through swirling snowflakes to an enchanting kingdom where she is transformed into the Sugar Plum Fairy. Tchaikovsky’s glorious score, performed live by the 60-strong Royal Ballet Sinfonia, provides the captivating soundtrack to this festive classic.

This sumptuous and timeless production boasts daring swordfights, falling snow, magic, and a 30-foot Christmas tree. Whether you’re yearning for a hint of nostalgia or looking to start a whole new tradition for your family and friends, The Nutcracker is just right.

Access Performances & Touch Tours


  • Touch Tour: Sat 28 Nov, 12.30pm. 
  • Audio Described by Jonathan Nash & Kerry Elkins: Sat 28 Nov, 2.30pm
  • Relaxed Performance: Tue 1 Dec, 12.45pm

title: One Tiny Penguin
desc:
Every year, a great big polar bear is chosen to light up the Northern Lights. This year, the special job falls to Lumi—but there’s a small problem. He’s not a polar bear at all. He’s just One Tiny Penguin! Families will follow Lumi as he gathers all his courage to travel the world, venturing out from the North Pole, to Chile, South Africa, and all the way to the South Pole to discover what it truly means to be brave.

Why We Can't Wait to Book

This production is the third show in Birmingham Hippodrome’s brilliant 'My First Musical' series, and it is firmly on our festive must-see list. If you've been following our theatre adventures, you'll know exactly how much James, Charlotte, and I LOVED The Jingleclaw in 2024, followed by No Such Thing As Wolves in 2025. We were honestly still singing those incredibly catchy songs well into the summer each year!

With an exciting cast led by Dylan Collymore (Shrek: The Musical), we are fully expecting this heart-warming adventure to have us tapping our toes and flapping our flippers just as much.

Family & Sensory Highlights

  • Ages 3+ Tailor-made for toddlers and early years. Babes in arms (under 18 months) are also welcome free of charge, though you will need to call the box office in advance to book them in.

  • 60 Mins (No Interval) The ideal, bite-sized running time to keep young attention spans engaged without risking mid-show meltdowns.

Access Performances & Touch Tours

  • BSL Performance: Sat 12 Dec 10.15am & Tue 15 Dec 10.15am
  • Audio Described Performance: Sat 12 Dec 10.15am & Tue 15 Dec 10.15am
  • Captioned Performance: Sat 12 Dec 10.15am & Tue 15 Dec 10.15am
  • Relaxed Performance: Sat 12 Dec 10.15am & Tue 15 Dec 10.15am

title: Father Christmas
desc:
Join Santa as he awakes from a dream of sun, sea, and sand only to find it is the busiest day of the year: Christmas Eve. Families will love watching as he prepares for his Christmas deliveries, feeds his reindeer, and finally takes flight into the snowy night.

Back for another brilliant year, Christmas isn’t Christmas without this Lyric Hammersmith family favourite, co-produced with the Olivier Award-nominated Pins & Needles Productions. Based on Raymond Briggs’ much-loved book and directed by Emma Earle, it is a wonderfully visual and engaging show, making it the perfect festive introduction to the theatre for very young audiences.

Family & Sensory Highlight

  • Under 6s Tailor-made specifically for early years, this production is designed as an ideal first-time theatre experience for toddlers and younger children.
  • 50 Mins A highly accessible, bite-sized running time perfectly suited to young attention spans. 
  • Seating & Booster Logistics: A limited number of Booster Seats are available to hire for free on the day on a first-come, first-served basis, or you are welcome to bring your own car booster seats. Please note: because of the steep rake, booster seats are not permitted in the balcony.   

Access Performances

  • Relaxed performance:  Tue 8th Dec at 11am
  • BSL Interpreted performances on Thu 10th Dec at 1.30pm and Sat 19th Dec at 11am.
